thread_text:
Evan: Heads-up — i brought Gizmo, my rescue axolotl, to the office for the afternoon. portable desk pond setup incoming 
Mia: wait WHAT is an axolotl??? tiny face forever :heart_eyes:
Evan: uploaded: <https://imgur.com/a/gizmo-pond|gizmo_desk.png> and short clip: <https://youtu.be/gizmo-wiggle> micro tank is filtered + lidted. temp steady at ~18C, no splashing so far 
Zoe: THAT FACE. looks like a plushie that learned to swim. also is that a tiny smile? :pleading_face:
Liam: are they allowed? will Gizmo try to eat my snack? :joy: Also, feeding question: bloodworms or frozen daphnia?
OpsBot: Reminder: guest pets must be registered. Aquatic pets require a sealed container, secondary spill prevention, and a care sheet uploaded to the pet-portal: https://intranet/pets. Please upload vaccination/care docs. 
Evan: registered Gizmo as a guest pet and uploaded the care sheet (water changes schedule + contact info). brought a hand towel to catch any accidental drips. no fishy incidents yet :sweat_smile:
Maya K.: official vote: name sticker? i volunteer to design a tiny "Gizmo visited" sticker for the snack fridge :sticker:
Mia: poll: Gizmo's vibe = 1) perpetual baby 2) tiny water monk 3) nocturnal overlord. cast with reactions :one::two::three:
Zoe: reacts with :one: and :two: 
Liam: votes :three: 972 dramatic but serene
Evan: posted a tiny captioned gif: "Gizmo wiggle = endowed calm". also note: please don't tap glass — axolotls get startled. sign on desk added: "Gizmo zone 90c please admire gently"
OpsBot: Thanks for registering Gizmo, Evan. If Gizmo visits become recurring, please submit a recurring pet schedule.
